التكلفة · The Cost

What it costs to OCR at scale

Estimated dollars per 1,000 pages on each vendor's hosted/managed API tier.

⚠ Estimated, unverified pricing. These numbers come from a research pass over public vendor pages, not from actual invoices or metered runs. Several vendors offer both a hosted API and a self-hosted option at very different price points — the bars below use each vendor's hosted/managed tier for a like-for-like comparison. Treat this as directional, not authoritative.
Why isn't FastOCR's $249.95 in the chart above? That figure is the actual price of running this one 5-page document through FastOCR's manual web dashboard — about $50/page — because that tier is sold in fixed "Enterprise Page Packs" rather than metered per page. The chart instead uses FastOCR's programmatic API tier ($1.50–$2.00/1,000 pages, quote-only) so all eight engines are compared on the same basis. See the FastOCR tab for the full detail.
